bsi.editorial_reason: 1 Chronicles 1:38 names Dishon among the sons of Seir, while 1 Chronicles 1:41 explicitly lists a different Dishon as a son of Anah and immediately repeats his name before naming his sons. Both WLC word tokens in 1:41 therefore refer to person:Dishon.2 (Anah's son), not person:Dishon (Seir's son). Only these two wrong direct-name claims and the now-unsupported 1:41 source reference are removed in the derived index; their original source fields remain immutable. Genesis 36:26 has a lexically different Dishan word in pinned WLC, so it is not guessed or reassigned here. | Gen 36:25 and 1 Chr 1:41 name the younger Dishon, son of Anah; the record Dishon has father Seir and own pinned source witnesses at Gen 36:21,26,30 and 1 Chr 1:38. The younger distinct person:Dishon.2 already owns both correct direct original-word witnesses. Remove these falsely attributed contextual keys rather than merging father and grandson.
